# Majid DS (mahdimajidzadeh/ds)

> RTL/Persian-first UI kit for Laravel Livewire, layered on top of Flux UI (livewire/flux, free tier).
> Adds an `mds:` Blade component namespace next to `flux:`: Persian digits/money, Jalali dates,
> e-commerce components, and open implementations of Flux Pro's command palette, color picker, file upload and timeline.
> This file is the complete machine-oriented API reference. Human docs: docs/index.html.

Requirements: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 11+, Livewire 3, Tailwind CSS v4. `livewire/flux ^2.0` is installed automatically.

## Setup contract

1. `composer require mahdimajidzadeh/ds` (service provider auto-discovered).
2. resources/css/app.css MUST import, in order:
   `@import 'tailwindcss';`
   `@import '../../vendor/livewire/flux/dist/flux.css';`
   `@import '../../vendor/mahdimajidzadeh/ds/resources/css/mds.css';`
   `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));`
3. Layout: `<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">`; `@mdsFonts` + `@fluxAppearance` in <head>; `@fluxScripts` before </body>.
4. Alpine is REQUIRED for interactive components (quantity, countdown, rating.input, command, color-picker, file-upload).
   Livewire injects Alpine only on pages rendering a Livewire component; on static pages add `@livewireScripts`.
5. Tag syntaxes are equivalent: `<mds:rating />` === `<x-mds::rating />`. Subcomponents use dots: `<mds:command.item>`.
6. Components follow Flux's `--color-accent` theme tokens and support dark mode via the `.dark` class.

## Config (config/mds.php; publish tag `mds-config`)

- `mds.currency` (default `'toman'`): default currency for price component/directives/helpers. Values: `toman` | `rial` | `none` | any literal label string.
- `mds.persian_digits` (default `true`): global default for Persian-digit rendering. Every component overrides per-instance via `:fa="true|false"`.

Publish tags: `mds-config` (config), `mds-views` (Blade views -> resources/views/mds/, app copies override package), `mds-assets` (mds.css copy).

## Blade directives

- `@fa($value)` -> Persian digits only ("order 123" -> "order ۱۲۳")
- `@faNum($value)` -> number with Persian separators (2500000 -> ۲٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰)
- `@toman($amount)` -> ۲٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان
- `@rial($amount)` -> ۹۹۰ ریال
- `@jalali($date)` -> ۲۹ مرداد ۱۴۰۵ (fixed 'j F Y'; custom formats via Mds::jalali())
- `@mdsFonts` -> Vazirmatn <link> tags (put in <head>)

## PHP API

Facade `MajidDs\Mds`:
- `Mds::fa($v): string` — digit conversion
- `Mds::number($v, int $decimals = 0): string`
- `Mds::money($amount, ?string $currency = null, int $decimals = 0): string`
- `Mds::toman($amount): string` / `Mds::rial($amount): string`
- `Mds::jalali($date, string $format = 'j F Y', ?bool $persianDigits = null): string`
- `Mds::ago($date): string` — «۳ ساعت پیش» / «۲ روز دیگر»
- `Mds::fileSize($bytes, ?bool $persianDigits = null): string` — «۱۵۹ کیلوبایت» / «۱٫۵ مگابایت»

`MajidDs\Support\Persian` (static): `digits`, `latinDigits` (Persian->Latin, for input normalization), `number`, `money`, `currencyLabel`, `ago`, `fileSize` (bytes -> بایت/کیلوبایت/مگابایت/گیگابایت/ترابایت, 1024-based, 1 decimal below 100 and none for whole numbers), `toDateTime` (DateTime|string|int -> DateTimeImmutable).

`MajidDs\Support\Jalali` (static, dependency-free, intl-verified):
- `fromGregorian(int $gy, int $gm, int $gd): array{0:int,1:int,2:int}` — e.g. (2026,8,20) -> [1405,5,29]
- `toGregorian(int $jy, int $jm, int $jd): array` — exact inverse
- `format($date, string $format = 'j F Y', ?bool $persianDigits = null): string`
- Format tokens: Y y n m j d F(month name) l/D(weekday name) + time passthroughs H G h g i s v, A/a (قبل‌ازظهر/بعدازظهر). Backslash escapes a token.
- Constants: `Jalali::MONTHS` (1-indexed Persian month names), `Jalali::WEEKDAYS` (keyed by PHP `w`, 0=Sunday).

## Livewire/form binding contract

Components with values render a hidden `<input>`; `wire:model` attributes are forwarded to it and it dispatches
bubbling `input` events on every change. Hidden values are ALWAYS Latin digits / machine formats regardless of
Persian display. Applies to: quantity, rating.input, color-picker. `name="..."` enables plain form posts.

## Components

### <mds:rating> — star display
Props: `value` float=0 (clamped 0..max, fractions = partial fill) · `max` int=5 · `count` int|null=null (review count) · `size` sm|lg|default · `show-value` bool=true · `fa` bool|null=config.
Renders role="img" with aria-label. RTL-correct partial fill.

### <mds:rating.input> — interactive stars
Props: `value` int=0 · `max` int=5 · `name` string|null · `size` sm|lg|default · `label` string='امتیاز'.
role="radiogroup"; hover preview; integer values; wire:model forwarded.

### <mds:price>
Props: `amount` number=0 · `original` number|null=null (compare-at; when > amount renders strikethrough + auto badge) · `currency` toman|rial|none|literal|null=config · `decimals` int=0 · `size` sm|lg|default · `fa` bool|null=config · `badge` bool=true (auto discount badge on/off).
Discount percent = round((1 - amount/original) * 100).

### <mds:discount-badge>
Props: `percent` int|null · `amount`+`original` number|null (computes percent when `percent` omitted) · `size` sm|lg|default · `fa`.
Red pill, Persian percent sign ٪.

### <mds:quantity> — cart stepper
Props: `value` int|null=min · `min` int=1 · `max` int|null=null · `step` int=1 · `size` sm|lg|default · `name` · `fa` · `increment-label`='افزایش تعداد' · `decrement-label`='کاهش تعداد'.
`+` sits at inline-start (right in RTL). Buttons disable at bounds. Hidden input = Latin digits.

### <mds:product-card>
Props: `title` string='' · `image` string|null · `href` string|null · `amount`/`original` number|null · `currency` · `rating` float|null · `reviews` int|null · `badge` string|null (corner flux:badge text) · `badge-color` string='lime' (any Flux badge color) · `unavailable` bool=false (grayscale + «ناموجود») · `fa`.
Slot = actions area (e.g. add-to-cart flux:button). Composes flux:card + mds:rating + mds:price + mds:discount-badge.

### <mds:stepper> — checkout steps
Props: `steps` array=[] (labels in order) · `current` int=1 (1-based active index) · `fa`.
States: completed (check, accent) / current (aria-current="step") / upcoming (muted). data-mds-stepper-step attr per state.

### <mds:countdown>
Props: `until` DateTime|string REQUIRED · `days` bool=true (false = hours accumulate) · `labels` bool=false ·
`size` sm|lg|default · `fa` · `expired-text` string='به پایان رسید'.
Server-renders initial segments (no blank flash), ticks via Alpine.
Direction contract: plain variant is dir="ltr" wall-clock (۰۷:۴۱:۵۵ hours-first); `labels` variant is RTL boxes
(days rightmost) with روز/ساعت/دقیقه/ثانیه labels — Iranian e-commerce convention. Do not override.

### <mds:jalali-date>
Props: `date` DateTime|string|int REQUIRED · `format` string='j F Y' (Jalali tokens above) · `fa` · `ago` bool=false.
Renders `<time datetime="<gregorian ISO>">`; `ago` mode shows relative text with full Jalali date in title attr.

### <mds:empty-state>
Props: `icon` string|null (heroicon name) · `title` string|null · `description` string|null. Slot = action buttons.

### <mds:command> — command palette (open version of Flux Pro's flux:command)
Wrapper holds state. Compose:
- `<mds:command.input>` props: `icon`='magnifying-glass' · `clearable` bool=false · `closable` bool=false (closes containing <dialog>/Flux modal) · `clear-label`='پاک کردن' · `close-label`='بستن' · plus any input attrs (placeholder, autofocus).
- `<mds:command.items>` props: `empty`='نتیجه‌ای یافت نشد.' (no-results text). Scrollable listbox.
- `<mds:command.item>` props: `icon` · `icon-variant`='micro' · `kbd` string|null (rendered LTR at inline-end) · `href` (renders <a>; else <button type="button">). wire:click / x-on:click pass through.
- `<mds:command.heading>` — group label, auto-hides while a query is typed.
Behavior: live filter with Persian normalization (Arabic ي/ك -> ی/ک; Persian/Arabic-Indic digits -> Latin before matching);
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move active item; Enter clicks it; hover syncs active state; built-in empty state.
Global ⌘K pattern (Flux free modal): `<flux:modal.trigger name="search" shortcut="cmd.k"><flux:input as="button" .../></flux:modal.trigger>`
+ `<flux:modal name="search" variant="bare" class="my-[12vh] w-full max-w-[30rem]"><mds:command>...</mds:command></flux:modal>`.

### <mds:color-picker> — color picker (open version of Flux Pro's flux:color-picker)
Props: `value` string|null (any supported color string; normalized to `format`) · `name` · `format` hex|hexa|rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla='hex'
(alpha formats add an alpha slider) · `type` input|button='input' · `label`/`description` (flux:field chrome) · `placeholder` ·
`swatches` array|false|null=20-color default palette (items: hex string or [value, label]) · `dropper` bool=false (EyeDropper API;
auto-hidden if unsupported) · `clearable` bool=false · `size` sm · `disabled` bool=false · `invalid` bool=false.
wire:model forwarded to hidden input (emits input events). Parses pasted hex(3/6/8-digit)/rgb(a)/hsl(a) strings.
Slot replaces the default popover layout; subcomponents share state:
- `<mds:color-picker.area />` — saturation/value canvas (pointer drag, always LTR)
- `<mds:color-picker.slider channel="hue|alpha" />` — native range inputs (keyboard accessible)
- `<mds:color-picker.input placeholder="#000000" />` — parses on change
- `<mds:color-picker.swatches>` + `<mds:color-picker.swatch value="#..." label="..." />`
- `<mds:color-picker.dropper label="قطره‌چکان" />`
RTL note: canvas/sliders stay physically LTR (universal convention); field chrome follows page direction.

### <mds:file-upload> — file upload (open version of Flux Pro's flux:file-upload)
Wrapper. Props: `name` string|null (`[]` auto-appended when `multiple`) · `multiple` bool=false · `accept` string|null (input accept list) ·
`label`/`description` (flux:field chrome) · `error` string|null (explicit message; when omitted and `name` is set, falls back to
`$errors->first($name)` then `$errors->first("$name.*")`) · `invalid` bool=false · `disabled` bool=false · `fa` bool|null=config.
Renders `flux:field` > `<label>` > sr-only `<input type="file" data-flux-control>` + slot. `wire:model` is forwarded to that input
(everything else lands on the wrapper), so Livewire's native upload pipeline handles the transfer.
Slot = the dropzone, or any custom markup (custom avatar uploader etc.).
Behavior: click anywhere in the slot opens the picker (native `<label>`, so keyboard Enter/Space on the focused input works too);
drag-and-drop writes `input.files` via DataTransfer and dispatches bubbling `change` + `input` (single-file mode keeps only the first drop).
Data attributes on the wrapper: `data-dragging` (file over the zone), `data-loading` (upload in flight) — style descendants with
Tailwind's `in-data-dragging:` / `in-data-loading:` prefixes. Also sets CSS custom properties on the wrapper:
`--mds-file-upload-progress` (Latin `42%`, for widths) and `--mds-file-upload-progress-as-string` (quoted, fa-aware `'۴۲٪'`, for `content:`).

### <mds:file-upload.dropzone>
Props: `heading` string='فایل را اینجا رها کنید یا برای انتخاب کلیک کنید' · `text` string|null (size/format hint) ·
`icon` string='cloud-arrow-up' · `inline` bool=false (compact horizontal layout) · `with-progress` bool=false (progress bar + percent
while uploading, replacing `text`; pair it with `text` so the idle state still reads).
Dashed border, accent border + tint while dragging, accent ring while the input is focus-visible, spinner swap while loading.
Must be rendered inside `<mds:file-upload>` (it reads that component's Alpine state).

### <mds:file-item>
Props: `heading` string|null (file name; `dir="auto"` so Latin names read correctly in RTL lists) · `text` string|null
(defaults to the formatted `size`) · `image` string|null (thumbnail URL) · `size` int|null (bytes -> Persian::fileSize) ·
`icon` string='document' (shown when no `image`) · `invalid` bool=false (red border/icon/text) · `fa` bool|null=config.
Named slot `actions` (inline-end) for buttons; default slot renders under the text column.
Sits OUTSIDE `<mds:file-upload>` — render one per uploaded file yourself (see the Livewire snippet below).

### <mds:file-item.remove>
Props: `icon` string='x-mark' · `label` string='حذف فایل' (becomes `aria-label`). `wire:click` / `x-on:click` pass through.

Livewire contract (same as Flux):
```php
use Livewire\WithFileUploads; use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
#[Validate(['photos.*' => 'image|max:10240'])] public $photos = [];
public function removePhoto($i) { $this->photos[$i]->delete(); unset($this->photos[$i]); $this->photos = array_values($this->photos); }
```
```blade
<mds:file-upload wire:model="photos" label="بارگذاری تصاویر" multiple>
    <mds:file-upload.dropzone text="JPG، PNG یا GIF تا ۱۰ مگابایت" with-progress />
</mds:file-upload>
<div class="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
    @foreach ($photos as $i => $photo)
        <mds:file-item :heading="$photo->getClientOriginalName()" :image="$photo->temporaryUrl()" :size="$photo->getSize()">
            <x-slot name="actions"><mds:file-item.remove wire:click="removePhoto({{ $i }})" :label="'حذف '.$photo->getClientOriginalName()" /></x-slot>
        </mds:file-item>
    @endforeach
</div>
```

## CSS layer (resources/css/mds.css)

- `@theme { --font-sans: 'Vazirmatn', ... }` — font-sans becomes Persian-ready.
- `[x-cloak] { display: none !important }`.
- `[dir='rtl'] input[type='tel'], [dir='rtl'] input[data-ltr]` — direction:ltr, text-align:end (phone/code inputs).
- `.mds-checker` — checkerboard backdrop for transparent colors.
- `.mds-range` — gradient range-slider styling (color-picker hue/alpha).
- `@layer components { [data-mds-timeline] ... }` — the timeline grid, connector lines and indicator states.
  It MUST stay inside `@layer components`: cascade layers outrank specificity, so unlayered rules would beat
  Tailwind's `@layer utilities` and swallow classes users put on an indicator (e.g. `bg-green-500`).

### <mds:timeline> — timeline (open version of Flux Pro's flux:timeline)
Container, renders `<ol>`. Props: `horizontal` bool=false (indicators along a row, content beneath) ·
`align` start|baseline|center|end='center' (cross-axis placement of the indicator against its content) · `size` lg|null.
CSS grid: vertical tracks are `[indicator] [content-gap] [content]`; `horizontal` transposes them to rows.
All offsets are logical, so the rail sits on the RIGHT in RTL and a horizontal timeline flows right-to-left.
CSS custom properties (set with an arbitrary class, e.g. `class="[--mds-timeline-item-gap:3rem]"`):
`--mds-timeline-item-gap` (1rem) · `--mds-timeline-content-gap` (0.75rem; 1rem when size=lg) ·
`--mds-timeline-indicator-size` (2rem; 3rem when size=lg) · `--mds-timeline-baseline` (1.25rem, the first
line-height used by `align="baseline"` — this replaces Flux's `[data-flux-timeline-baseline]` font-size trick).

### <mds:timeline.item>
Renders `<li>`. Props: `status` complete|current|incomplete|null · `align` (per-item override; inherited from the
timeline via @aware when omitted) · `size` lg|null (per-item indicator size).
Draws its own leading/trailing connector lines; the first item's leading and the last item's trailing line are
hidden, and a `complete` item paints the rail up to the next indicator in `--color-accent`.
`status="incomplete"` also dims its content to 75%.

### <mds:timeline.indicator>
The dot between the lines — put an icon, a number, or text in the slot. Props: `variant` bare|null
(strips the circle/size so a standalone icon can be the marker) · `status` (overrides the item's) ·
`color` red|orange|amber|yellow|lime|green|emerald|teal|cyan|sky|blue|indigo|violet|purple|fuchsia|pink|rose|zinc|null.
Defaults: zinc chip; `complete` = accent fill, `current` = accent ring, `incomplete` = muted ring.
An explicit `color` outranks `status` (real utility classes beat the layer's defaults).

### <mds:timeline.content>
The cell next to the indicator. No props.

### <mds:timeline.block>
Full-width item body with no indicator column — for callouts, cards, comment threads. Spans every track;
its direct children span the full width unless they are `<mds:timeline.subgrid>`.

### <mds:timeline.subgrid>
Used inside a block to re-align to the timeline's tracks: the first child lands in the indicator track
(centered), every later child in the content track. Vertical timelines only.

Typical order-tracking timeline (Jalali dates, RTL rail):
```blade
<mds:timeline horizontal>
    <mds:timeline.item status="complete">
        <mds:timeline.indicator><flux:icon icon="credit-card" variant="micro" /></mds:timeline.indicator>
        <mds:timeline.content><flux:heading>پرداخت شد</flux:heading><flux:text>@jalali($order->paid_at)</flux:text></mds:timeline.content>
    </mds:timeline.item>
    <mds:timeline.item status="current">
        <mds:timeline.indicator><flux:icon icon="truck" variant="micro" /></mds:timeline.indicator>
        <mds:timeline.content><flux:heading>در حال ارسال</flux:heading></mds:timeline.content>
    </mds:timeline.item>
    <mds:timeline.item status="incomplete">
        <mds:timeline.indicator><flux:icon icon="home" variant="micro" /></mds:timeline.indicator>
        <mds:timeline.content><flux:heading>تحویل به مشتری</flux:heading></mds:timeline.content>
    </mds:timeline.item>
</mds:timeline>
```

## Rules of thumb for generated code

- Prefer `<mds:*>` and `<flux:*>` components over raw HTML in Blade views.
- Use logical utilities (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/start-/end-) — never ml-/mr-/left-/right- — so RTL keeps working.
- Money: never hardcode number_format for prices; use <mds:price>, @toman/@rial, or Persian::money().
- Dates shown to users: Jalali via <mds:jalali-date> or Mds::jalali(); machine values stay Gregorian ISO.
- Keep phone/OTP/code inputs LTR: type="tel" or data-ltr attribute.
- Persian digits are display-only; anything submitted/bound stays Latin (the components already guarantee this).
- Flux free components available alongside: avatar, badge, brand, breadcrumbs, button, callout, card, checkbox,
  dropdown/menu, field, heading, icon, input, modal, navbar, otp, pagination, profile, progress, radio, select,
  separator, skeleton, switch, table, text, textarea, toast, tooltip. Flux Pro-only components NOT available
  unless licensed: autocomplete, calendar, chart, date-picker, editor, tabs, etc. — use mds:command and
  mds:command, mds:color-picker, mds:file-upload and mds:timeline instead of flux:command / flux:color-picker /
  flux:file-upload / flux:timeline.
- File sizes shown to users: <mds:file-item :size="$bytes" /> or Persian::fileSize() — never a hand-rolled KB/MB formatter.
